name: Mailchimp
whatYouLose: Deliverability: warmed IPs, reputation, feedback loops and bounce handling
Legal compliance tooling (CAN-SPAM, GDPR consent, unsubscribe handling at scale)
Drag-and-drop email builder that renders in Outlook
prompt:
Build a newsletter manager on top of a transactional email API (Postmark, SES or Resend), a small-list Mailchimp alternative.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, server-rendered admin.
Features:
- Double opt-in signup form and embeddable snippet; one-click unsubscribe (List-Unsubscribe header).
- Lists and tags; CSV import with deduplication.
- Compose in markdown → responsive HTML email with a single tested template; send test email.
- Batched sending through the provider API with rate limiting; handle bounce and complaint webhooks by suppressing addresses.
- Per-campaign open/click stats (tracking optional and off by default).
Done when: I can import 50 contacts, send a campaign through the provider sandbox and see bounces suppressed.
notes: You can build the software. You cannot prompt your way into inbox placement. Use a sending provider and keep your list small, or keep paying.
